mcqs.question: Under the rationalisation of Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva treatments in Andhra Pradesh, how many treatments were added to government hospitals, taking the total to 324?
mcqs.explanation: A total of 155 treatments were added to government hospitals, taking the overall number to 324. The figures 197 and 319 refer to other aspects of the treatment rationalisation, while 2,550 denotes categories handled through the insurance company.
